notes.title: Maid For My Master has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that my newest cute romance visual novel, [i]Maid For My Master,[/i] has been released!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/744d18ffded921ed2034fe75ce27515cec756b50.png[/img]

This announcement post is a bit late, since the VN was actually released over a week ago, but I had a lot of difficulties trying to post this announcement. I tried to post it multiple times, but for reasons unknown to me, the announcement refused to show up on my developer page and in the community hub of the game.

Hopefully the announcement will post properly this time.

ANYWAY

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/cbaf9681d0be7a6a8ec3a303b7f37c221bc159d8.png[/img]

[i]Maid For My Master[/i] a wholesome romance story somewhat inspired by [i]Chobits[/i] where you can date a cute robot maid, Holly!

The story is light-hearted and sweet, so it should be perfect if you want to read something relaxing.

The visual novel has an optional r18 patch, but it doesn't add an extensive amount of new scenes. Feel free to miss it if you would rather not read it; it's up to you!

You can check out the visual novel here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364490

I hope you enjoy it if you do check it out, and you have a good time with Holly!

- ebi x

notes.title: Cute romance VN Maid For My Master has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that[i] Maid For My Master[/i] has been released!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/744d18ffded921ed2034fe75ce27515cec756b50.png[/img]

[i]Maid For My Master[/i] is a cute BxG visual novel about a young man who falls in love with a robot maid. The story is very light-hearted, and it was partially inspired by [i]Chobits.[/i]

The story contains a little bit of drama, but it does have a happy ending, and it doesn't contain any especially upsetting content. I think this would be a good story to read if you want something sweet and hopeful to cheer you up!

There is an adult patch for the game available on Steam, but it isn't necessary to enjoy the story. Feel free to download the patch or not; it's up to you.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/cbaf9681d0be7a6a8ec3a303b7f37c221bc159d8.png[/img]

You can find the VN here if you want to read it:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364490

As always, thank you for supporting me while I release so many projects. I hope you enjoy [i]Maid For My Master[/i] if you do choose to check it out, and you have a good time with Holly!

- ebi x
